fullDescription: Full-bleed cobalt-on-white contact page for an AI product-design tool (Lumen): a sticky translucent nav and a centered 'Let's build your next interface.' headline with a 1-day-reply / every-timezone / no-spam trust line over ONE centered white card -- a 'Send us a message' header strip above a form (a first/last name row, a work-email + team-size select row, a 'What are you working on?' textarea, a Product/Billing/Partnership topic chip row and a cobalt 'Send message' CTA) topped by a cobalt gradient hairline -- then a labelled 'Other ways to reach us' divider into three hover-lift info cards (Help center / Community / Developer API) and a slim footer.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, full-bleed contact page for an AI product-design tool (Lumen / Superdesign), built on the classic single-centered-card pattern: the whole page is one white sheet with a soft cobalt glow up top, and a centered card holds the message form. The page opens with a sticky translucent nav, then a centered eyebrow + headline ('Let's build your next interface.') with a three-item trust line, then ONE centered white card carrying a top cobalt gradient hairline and a 'Send us a message' header strip over a form: a first/last name row, a work-email + team-size select row, a 'What are you working on?' textarea, a topic chip row, a full-width cobalt 'Send message' CTA and a reassurance line. Below the card a labelled divider ('Other ways to reach us') leads into a three-up row of hoverable info cards (Help center / Community / Developer API), and a slim footer closes the page. The mood is clean, confident and reassuring: a single cobalt accent on a near-white slate canvas, Inter type, soft layered shadows, a faint dot-grain texture and a cobalt glow behind the hero.

## Estilo Visual
Design a full-bleed contact page for a friendly AI product-design tool. Use a near-white slate canvas (#f8fafc) with near-black slate-ink text (#0f172a). Keep ONE accent family: a cobalt ramp (#2563eb brand, #1d4ed8 for hover/dark, #eff4ff soft tint, #bfdbfe ring) with a neutral slate scale for body and borders (#475569 nav/labels, #64748b body, #e2e8f0 lines, #94a3b8 placeholders). Type is Inter, weights 400-800, with a tight -0.011em body letter-spacing: a font-extrabold (800) hero H1 ~42px (52px on sm+) with tight tracking and leading 1.04, font-bold (700) ~17px card headings, font-semibold (600) 13.5px field labels, muted ~15-17px body. Round things generously: rounded-2xl (16px) main card and info cards, rounded-xl (12px) inputs/buttons/icon-tiles, rounded-lg (8px) logo tiles and the top-right pill, rounded-full chips and pills. Build the centerpiece as a single centered card: ONE white card (max-w-[660px], rounded-2xl, a 1px line border, overflow-hidden, a soft 'card' shadow of 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04) plus 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)) topped by a 1px cobalt gradient hairline (from cobalt via cobalt-dark to cobalt) and a header strip (a rounded-xl cobalt-soft tile with a cobalt paper-plane icon beside 'Send us a message' + 'It takes about a minute.'), with the form below. Inputs are canvas-fill (#f8fafc) with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) border that on focus turns cobalt #2563eb with a 4px rgba(37,99,235,0.14) ring and a white fill; placeholders are #94a3b8. The primary CTA is a full-width rounded-xl cobalt (#2563eb) button in white font-semibold text with a 'btn' cobalt glow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)) and a leading paper-plane icon that darkens to cobalt-dark (#1d4ed8) on hover and lifts 1px. Behind the hero, add a soft cobalt glow (a 420px gradient from a cobalt-soft tint to transparent) and a faint '.grain' dot layer (radial-gradient circle at 1px 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.045) on a 22px cell). Add micro-interactions: a CTA that lifts on hover, info cards that lift 3px with a cobalt-ring border and a deeper shadow on hover, nav links with a grow-on-hover 2px cobalt underline, and an ink 'Start free' pill that flips to cobalt on hover. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:chat-circle-dots-fill, ph:lightning-fill, ph:globe-hemisphere-west-fill, ph:shield-check-fill, ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:paper-plane-right-fill, ph:books-fill, ph:discord-logo-fill, ph:terminal-window-fill). Mood: clean, confident, friendly, reassuring, premium but approachable, never corporate.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent nav
A sticky top header, z-50, full width, with a canvas/85 background and a backdrop blur, a 1px bottom border in line (#e2e8f0) and a 'nav' hairline shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(15,23,42,0.05)). Inner row mx-auto max-w-6xl, ~24-32px side padding (px-6 lg:px-8), 64px tall (h-16), space-between. Left: the logo = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg cobalt (#2563eb) tile with a 'btn' shadow holding a white ph:sparkle-fill icon, beside a 17px font-bold tight-tracked 'Lumen' wordmark in ink (#0f172a). Center (md+ only): four nav links 'Library', 'Canvas', 'Pricing' in 14.5px font-medium slate2 (#475569) (each with a grow-on-hover 2px cobalt underline, hovering to ink) and 'Contact' active in cobalt (#2563eb). Right: a 'Sign in' text link (slate2, sm+ only, hovering to ink) and a 'Start free' button = an ink (#0f172a) rounded-lg pill, 14px font-semibold white text with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold, flipping to a cobalt background on hover.

### Hero ground + eyebrow + headline + trust line
A full-width <main id='contact'> with the slate canvas ground and a '.grain' dot layer (a radial-gradient circle at 1px 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.045) 1px on a 22px cell). Behind the top, pointer-events-none, a soft cobalt glow: an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[420px] gradient from cobalt-soft/70 (#eff4ff) to transparent. Inner container mx-auto max-w-6xl, ~24-32px side padding, pt-20 pb-24. Centered eyebrow + headline block (mx-auto max-w-2xl, text-center): an inline-flex rounded-full white/70 pill with a 1px cobalt-ring (#bfdbfe) border and a soft shadow holding a small ph:chat-circle-dots-fill icon and 'We reply fast' in 12.5px font-semibold cobalt-dark (#1d4ed8); then an H1 'Let's build your next interface.' in 42px (52px on sm+) font-extrabold tight-tracked ink leading-[1.04] (with a line break before 'next interface.' on sm+); then a 17px leading-relaxed muted (#64748b) sub-line 'Questions about the canvas, the prompt library, or a custom design workflow? Tell us a bit, and a real human gets back to you.'; then a centered trust line (mt-6, gap-5, 13px font-medium slate2): three items each a cobalt-icon + label ('1-day reply' ph:lightning-fill, 'Every timezone' ph:globe-hemisphere-west-fill, 'No spam' ph:shield-check-fill) separated by 12px-tall thin line (#e2e8f0) dividers.

### Centered card shell + header strip
Center a max-w-[660px] card (mx-auto, mt-11): a white card, rounded-2xl (16px), overflow-hidden, with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) border and a soft 'card' shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)). Top edge: a 1px-tall full-width gradient hairline left-to-right from cobalt via cobalt-dark to cobalt. Then a header strip: a flex items-center gap-3 row with a 1px line bottom border, ~28-36px padding (px-7 py-5 / sm:px-9), holding a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl cobalt-soft (#eff4ff) tile with a cobalt ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill icon, beside an H2 'Send us a message' in 17px font-bold tight ink + a 13.5px muted sub-line 'It takes about a minute.'

### Form body
Inside the card, a form (px-7 py-7 / sm:px-9 sm:py-8). (1) A responsive grid (grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2): 'First name' (placeholder 'Ada'), 'Last name' (placeholder 'Lovelace'), 'Work email' (placeholder 'ada@studio.com'), and 'Team size' = a custom appearance-none select (options 'Just me' / '2-10' / '11-50' / '50+') with a trailing muted ph:caret-down-bold chevron. Each field has a 13.5px font-semibold ink label (mb-1.5) over a rounded-xl input with a 1px line border and a canvas (#f8fafc) fill, ~16px/12px padding, 15px ink text, #94a3b8 placeholders. (2) Below the grid (mt-5): a 'What are you working on?' label over a 4-row resize-none textarea (placeholder 'Tell us about the screens you want to design, the stack you ship to, or anything else...'). All fields share the focus treatment: border turns cobalt #2563eb with a 4px rgba(37,99,235,0.14) ring and a white fill. (3) A topic chip row (mt-4, flex-wrap gap-2): a 13px muted 'Topic:' label then three rounded-full chips: 'Product' selected (a 1px cobalt border, cobalt-soft fill, font-semibold cobalt-dark text), 'Billing' and 'Partnership' unselected (a 1px line border, white fill, font-medium slate2, hovering to a cobalt-ring border). (4) The submit CTA = a full-width rounded-xl cobalt (#2563eb) button (mt-7) with a leading ph:paper-plane-right-fill and 15.5px font-semibold white 'Send message', a 'btn' cobalt glow shadow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)), hovering to cobalt-dark and lifting 1px (settling on press). (5) A centered reassurance line (mt-4): 13.5px muted 'We reply within 1 business day. No bots, promise.'

### Labelled divider
Below the card (mx-auto mt-20 max-w-5xl), a labelled divider: a flex items-center gap-4 row with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) rule flexing on each side of a centered 13px font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider muted (#64748b) 'Other ways to reach us' label.

### Info card trio
A responsive grid (mx-auto mt-10 max-w-5xl, grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) of three '<a>' info cards. Each card is a rounded-2xl white card with a 1px line border and a soft shadow, ~24px padding, holding a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl cobalt-soft (#eff4ff) tile with a 22px cobalt Phosphor icon, then a 16px font-bold ink title (mt-4), a 14px leading-relaxed muted body, and a cobalt 'action' row (mt-4, 14px font-semibold) with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold. Card 1 'Help center' (ph:books-fill) / 'Guides for the canvas, prompts, and exporting to code.' / 'Browse docs'. Card 2 'Community' (ph:discord-logo-fill) / 'Swap prompts and templates with 6k designers and devs.' / 'Join Discord'. Card 3 'Developer API' (ph:terminal-window-fill) / 'Drive the canvas from your coding agent. Read the quickstart.' / 'API reference'. On hover each card lifts 3px, its border turns cobalt-ring (#c7d2fe) and its shadow deepens.

### Footer
Close the page with a full-width footer: a 1px top border in line (#e2e8f0) on white, inner mx-auto max-w-6xl row ~32px vertical padding, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on sm+: left a small 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-lg cobalt ph:sparkle-fill logo tile + 'Lumen - design at the speed of prompt.' in 14px font-semibold slate2; right 'Privacy' / 'Terms' / 'Status' links in 13.5px muted, hovering to ink.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Single centered card form: ONE white card (max-w-[660px], rounded-2xl, a 1px line border, overflow-hidden, a soft layered 'card' shadow) topped by a 1px cobalt gradient hairline (cobalt -> cobalt-dark -> cobalt) and a header strip (a cobalt-soft tile + a cobalt paper-plane icon beside 'Send us a message' / 'It takes about a minute.'), with the form below; the whole page is one white sheet, no split panel.

### Componente
Cobalt gradient top-hairline: a 1px-tall full-width gradient strip on the card's top edge, left-to-right from cobalt (#2563eb) via cobalt-dark (#1d4ed8) back to cobalt, reading as a thin brand accent over the white card.

### Componente
Focus-reactive canvas inputs: canvas-fill (#f8fafc) inputs with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) border that on focus turns cobalt #2563eb with a 4px rgba(37,99,235,0.14) ring and a white fill; includes a custom appearance-none 'Team size' select with a Phosphor caret and a 4-row resize-none textarea, with #94a3b8 placeholders.

### Componente
Topic chip row: a 'Topic:' label beside three rounded-full chips - one selected (a 1px cobalt border, cobalt-soft fill, font-semibold cobalt-dark) and two unselected (a 1px line border, white fill, font-medium slate2, hovering to a cobalt-ring border).

### Componente
Cobalt primary CTA: a full-width rounded-xl cobalt (#2563eb) button with a leading paper-plane icon and white font-semibold 'Send message' text, a 'btn' cobalt glow shadow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)), darkening to cobalt-dark and lifting 1px on hover (settling on press).

### Componente
Hover-lift info cards: three rounded-2xl white cards each with a cobalt-soft icon tile, a bold title, a muted body and a cobalt 'action' link with a trailing arrow; on hover each lifts 3px, its border turns cobalt-ring (#c7d2fe) and its shadow deepens.

### Componente
Labelled divider: a centered 'Other ways to reach us' uppercase tracking-wider muted label flanked by thin line (#e2e8f0) rules on each side.

### Componente
Sticky translucent nav: a sticky z-50 canvas/85 + backdrop-blur header with a 1px line bottom border and a nav hairline shadow, a cobalt ph:sparkle-fill logo tile + a 'Lumen' wordmark, Library/Canvas/Pricing/Contact links (Contact active in cobalt, grow-on-hover cobalt underlines) and a 'Sign in' link + an ink 'Start free' pill that flips to cobalt on hover.

### Componente
Ambient hero treatment: a faint '.grain' dot texture (radial-gradient circle at 1px 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.045) on a 22px cell) over the page plus a soft 420px cobalt glow (a gradient from cobalt-soft/70 to transparent) behind the top, with a centered 'We reply fast' eyebrow pill and a three-item trust line (1-day reply / Every timezone / No spam) under the headline.

## Notas Especiais
Keep the single-accent cobalt-on-canvas system: a near-white slate canvas (#f8fafc) page with near-black slate-ink text (#0f172a), one cobalt accent ramp (cobalt #2563eb brand, cobalt-dark #1d4ed8 hover, cobalt-soft #eff4ff tint, cobalt-ring #bfdbfe ring) and a neutral slate scale for body/borders (slate2 #475569, muted #64748b, line #e2e8f0, #94a3b8 placeholders); no second hue. Use Inter throughout (weights 400-800) with a tight -0.011em body letter-spacing: the hero H1 is font-extrabold ~42px (52px sm+) tight-tracked leading-[1.04], card headings font-bold ~17px, labels font-semibold 13.5px, body muted ~15-17px. Radii are generous: rounded-2xl (16px) main card + info cards, rounded-xl (12px) inputs/buttons/icon-tiles, rounded-lg (8px) logo tiles + the 'Start free' pill, rounded-full chips/pills. Depth is soft and layered: the 'card' shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04) + 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)) on the main card, a 'btn' cobalt glow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)) on the CTA and logo tile, and a 'nav' hairline shadow on the sticky header. The signature is the SINGLE centered card: ONE white max-w-[660px] card with a cobalt gradient top-hairline and a 'Send us a message' header strip over a form (a first/last name row, a work-email + team-size select row, a 'What are you working on?' textarea, a topic chip row, the cobalt 'Send message' CTA and a reassurance line), backed by focus-reactive canvas inputs that turn cobalt on focus (4px cobalt/14 ring + white fill). Below the card, a labelled 'Other ways to reach us' divider leads into three hover-lift info cards (Help center / Community / Developer API), each lifting 3px with a cobalt-ring border on hover. Add ambient texture: a faint '.grain' dot layer over the page plus a soft 420px cobalt glow behind the top of the hero. Micro-interactions: the CTA lifts on hover, info cards lift with a cobalt-ring border + deeper shadow, nav links grow a cobalt underline on hover, and the ink 'Start free' pill flips to cobalt on hover. Top it with a sticky translucent (canvas/85 + backdrop-blur) nav (a cobalt ph:sparkle-fill logo tile + a 'Lumen' wordmark, Library/Canvas/Pricing/Contact links with 'Contact' active in cobalt, a 'Sign in' link + an ink rounded-lg 'Start free' pill) and close with a slim footer ('Lumen - design at the speed of prompt.', Privacy / Terms / Status links). Everything must reflow cleanly: the name fields and the work-email/team-size fields go single-column below sm and 2-col on sm+, the info-card trio goes 1-col / 2-col (sm) / 3-col (lg), the nav center links hide below md and 'Sign in' below sm, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, human and reassuring with zero em-dashes. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:*).

prompts.prompt: Center a max-w-[660px] card (mx-auto, mt-11): a white card, rounded-2xl (16px), overflow-hidden, with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) border and a soft 'card' shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)). Top edge: a 1px-tall full-width gradient hairline left-to-right from cobalt via cobalt-dark to cobalt. Then a header strip: a flex items-center gap-3 row with a 1px line bottom border, ~28-36px padding (px-7 py-5 / sm:px-9), holding a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl cobalt-soft (#eff4ff) tile with a cobalt ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill icon, beside an H2 'Send us a message' in 17px font-bold tight ink + a 13.5px muted sub-line 'It takes about a minute.'

Inside the card, a form (px-7 py-7 / sm:px-9 sm:py-8). (1) A responsive grid (grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2): 'First name' (placeholder 'Ada'), 'Last name' (placeholder 'Lovelace'), 'Work email' (placeholder 'ada@studio.com'), and 'Team size' = a custom appearance-none select (options 'Just me' / '2-10' / '11-50' / '50+') with a trailing muted ph:caret-down-bold chevron. Each field has a 13.5px font-semibold ink label (mb-1.5) over a rounded-xl input with a 1px line border and a canvas (#f8fafc) fill, ~16px/12px padding, 15px ink text, #94a3b8 placeholders. (2) Below the grid (mt-5): a 'What are you working on?' label over a 4-row resize-none textarea (placeholder 'Tell us about the screens you want to design, the stack you ship to, or anything else...'). All fields share the focus treatment: border turns cobalt #2563eb with a 4px rgba(37,99,235,0.14) ring and a white fill. (3) A topic chip row (mt-4, flex-wrap gap-2): a 13px muted 'Topic:' label then three rounded-full chips: 'Product' selected (a 1px cobalt border, cobalt-soft fill, font-semibold cobalt-dark text), 'Billing' and 'Partnership' unselected (a 1px line border, white fill, font-medium slate2, hovering to a cobalt-ring border). (4) The submit CTA = a full-width rounded-xl cobalt (#2563eb) button (mt-7) with a leading ph:paper-plane-right-fill and 15.5px font-semibold white 'Send message', a 'btn' cobalt glow shadow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)), hovering to cobalt-dark and lifting 1px (settling on press). (5) A centered reassurance line (mt-4): 13.5px muted 'We reply within 1 business day. No bots, promise.'

Below the card (mx-auto mt-20 max-w-5xl), a labelled divider: a flex items-center gap-4 row with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) rule flexing on each side of a centered 13px font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider muted (#64748b) 'Other ways to reach us' label.

A responsive grid (mx-auto mt-10 max-w-5xl, grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) of three '<a>' info cards. Each card is a rounded-2xl white card with a 1px line border and a soft shadow, ~24px padding, holding a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl cobalt-soft (#eff4ff) tile with a 22px cobalt Phosphor icon, then a 16px font-bold ink title (mt-4), a 14px leading-relaxed muted body, and a cobalt 'action' row (mt-4, 14px font-semibold) with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold. Card 1 'Help center' (ph:books-fill) / 'Guides for the canvas, prompts, and exporting to code.' / 'Browse docs'. Card 2 'Community' (ph:discord-logo-fill) / 'Swap prompts and templates with 6k designers and devs.' / 'Join Discord'. Card 3 'Developer API' (ph:terminal-window-fill) / 'Drive the canvas from your coding agent. Read the quickstart.' / 'API reference'. On hover each card lifts 3px, its border turns cobalt-ring (#c7d2fe) and its shadow deepens.

Close the page with a full-width footer: a 1px top border in line (#e2e8f0) on white, inner mx-auto max-w-6xl row ~32px vertical padding, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on sm+: left a small 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-lg cobalt ph:sparkle-fill logo tile + 'Lumen - design at the speed of prompt.' in 14px font-semibold slate2; right 'Privacy' / 'Terms' / 'Status' links in 13.5px muted, hovering to ink.

special_ui_components.prompt: Single centered card form: ONE white card (max-w-[660px], rounded-2xl, a 1px line border, overflow-hidden, a soft layered 'card' shadow) topped by a 1px cobalt gradient hairline (cobalt -> cobalt-dark -> cobalt) and a header strip (a cobalt-soft tile + a cobalt paper-plane icon beside 'Send us a message' / 'It takes about a minute.'), with the form below; the whole page is one white sheet, no split panel.

Cobalt gradient top-hairline: a 1px-tall full-width gradient strip on the card's top edge, left-to-right from cobalt (#2563eb) via cobalt-dark (#1d4ed8) back to cobalt, reading as a thin brand accent over the white card.

Focus-reactive canvas inputs: canvas-fill (#f8fafc) inputs with a 1px line (#e2e8f0) border that on focus turns cobalt #2563eb with a 4px rgba(37,99,235,0.14) ring and a white fill; includes a custom appearance-none 'Team size' select with a Phosphor caret and a 4-row resize-none textarea, with #94a3b8 placeholders.

Topic chip row: a 'Topic:' label beside three rounded-full chips - one selected (a 1px cobalt border, cobalt-soft fill, font-semibold cobalt-dark) and two unselected (a 1px line border, white fill, font-medium slate2, hovering to a cobalt-ring border).

Cobalt primary CTA: a full-width rounded-xl cobalt (#2563eb) button with a leading paper-plane icon and white font-semibold 'Send message' text, a 'btn' cobalt glow shadow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)), darkening to cobalt-dark and lifting 1px on hover (settling on press).

Hover-lift info cards: three rounded-2xl white cards each with a cobalt-soft icon tile, a bold title, a muted body and a cobalt 'action' link with a trailing arrow; on hover each lifts 3px, its border turns cobalt-ring (#c7d2fe) and its shadow deepens.
Labelled divider: a centered 'Other ways to reach us' uppercase tracking-wider muted label flanked by thin line (#e2e8f0) rules on each side.

Sticky translucent nav: a sticky z-50 canvas/85 + backdrop-blur header with a 1px line bottom border and a nav hairline shadow, a cobalt ph:sparkle-fill logo tile + a 'Lumen' wordmark, Library/Canvas/Pricing/Contact links (Contact active in cobalt, grow-on-hover cobalt underlines) and a 'Sign in' link + an ink 'Start free' pill that flips to cobalt on hover.

Ambient hero treatment: a faint '.grain' dot texture (radial-gradient circle at 1px 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.045) on a 22px cell) over the page plus a soft 420px cobalt glow (a gradient from cobalt-soft/70 to transparent) behind the top, with a centered 'We reply fast' eyebrow pill and a three-item trust line (1-day reply / Every timezone / No spam) under the headline.

structured.special_notes: Keep the single-accent cobalt-on-canvas system: a near-white slate canvas (#f8fafc) page with near-black slate-ink text (#0f172a), one cobalt accent ramp (cobalt #2563eb brand, cobalt-dark #1d4ed8 hover, cobalt-soft #eff4ff tint, cobalt-ring #bfdbfe ring) and a neutral slate scale for body/borders (slate2 #475569, muted #64748b, line #e2e8f0, #94a3b8 placeholders); no second hue. Use Inter throughout (weights 400-800) with a tight -0.011em body letter-spacing: the hero H1 is font-extrabold ~42px (52px sm+) tight-tracked leading-[1.04], card headings font-bold ~17px, labels font-semibold 13.5px, body muted ~15-17px. Radii are generous: rounded-2xl (16px) main card + info cards, rounded-xl (12px) inputs/buttons/icon-tiles, rounded-lg (8px) logo tiles + the 'Start free' pill, rounded-full chips/pills. Depth is soft and layered: the 'card' shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04) + 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)) on the main card, a 'btn' cobalt glow (0 8px 20px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55)) on the CTA and logo tile, and a 'nav' hairline shadow on the sticky header. The signature is the SINGLE centered card: ONE white max-w-[660px] card with a cobalt gradient top-hairline and a 'Send us a message' header strip over a form (a first/last name row, a work-email + team-size select row, a 'What are you working on?' textarea, a topic chip row, the cobalt 'Send message' CTA and a reassurance line), backed by focus-reactive canvas inputs that turn cobalt on focus (4px cobalt/14 ring + white fill). Below the card, a labelled 'Other ways to reach us' divider leads into three hover-lift info cards (Help center / Community / Developer API), each lifting 3px with a cobalt-ring border on hover. Add ambient texture: a faint '.grain' dot layer over the page plus a soft 420px cobalt glow behind the top of the hero. Micro-interactions: the CTA lifts on hover, info cards lift with a cobalt-ring border + deeper shadow, nav links grow a cobalt underline on hover, and the ink 'Start free' pill flips to cobalt on hover. Top it with a sticky translucent (canvas/85 + backdrop-blur) nav (a cobalt ph:sparkle-fill logo tile + a 'Lumen' wordmark, Library/Canvas/Pricing/Contact links with 'Contact' active in cobalt, a 'Sign in' link + an ink rounded-lg 'Start free' pill) and close with a slim footer ('Lumen - design at the speed of prompt.', Privacy / Terms / Status links). Everything must reflow cleanly: the name fields and the work-email/team-size fields go single-column below sm and 2-col on sm+, the info-card trio goes 1-col / 2-col (sm) / 3-col (lg), the nav center links hide below md and 'Sign in' below sm, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, human and reassuring with zero em-dashes. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:*).
